description: List repository webhooks. page/limit control pagination (default: page 1, limit 30); a limit above this instance's max_response_items is refused, not clamped. Returns a response envelope {hooks, page, limit, count, total_count, has_next}; total_count appears only when Forgejo reports X-Total-Count. has_next true means a further page may exist; re-issue the call with page incremented to fetch it.
name: list_repo_hooks
